architecture: synthetic little-endian 64-bit address-space model: byte-addressed ram space, constant space; no processor instruction decoding
compiler_spec: N/A: manager-level fixture constructs the StringManager objects directly (native StringManagerUnicode(this,2048) and the declared-contract StringManager subclass) and never invokes a prototype model

analysis_options.declared_detection_contract: JAVA CONTRACT (explicitly declared, B4 decisive finding): the production manager implements the GhidraStringManager/Java semantics (string_ghidra.cc:42-56 via GETSTRINGDATA ghidra_arch.cc:780-810) — detection is charset-valid + NUL-terminated with NO 2048 search bound; maximumChars=2048 truncates only the returned bytes (assignStringData/writeUnicode count cap) and sets isTruncated. The native StringManagerUnicode 2048-byte search clamp (stringmanage.cc:452-457) is NOT the oracle golden behavior: tests/golden/ghidra_curl_1204.c hugehelp prints 2048-char TRUNCATED literals for strings whose NUL is at byte 3354-10329, impossible under the clamp. Both behaviors are locked side by side by this fixture (c5).
analysis_options.string_manager: maximumChars=2048 for both managers; incremental 32-byte loadimage reads; per-block hasCharTerminator; full-buffer checkCharacters; assignStringData block-copy/truncate; cache keyed by full Address with entry allocation before the read (negative cache)
analysis_options.attempt_counting: fixture loader counts loadFill attempts per start offset including attempts that throw DataUnavailError, so cached-query proofs show zero further attempts

input: ordered manager queries on one shared attempt-counting loadimage: native+contract at 0x2000 (ascii, twice), 0x2100 (0xAD invalid, twice), 0x2400 (2050-char string: native clamp vs contract truncation); fresh contract manager two-consumer share at 0x2000; contract at 0x3000 (data unavail, twice), 0x2E00 (no terminator, twice), 0x2080 (opaque, once); registerInternalStringData at ram:0x1000 for 'internal\0' and illegal 0xAD bytes; calcInternalHash determinism value; final entry counts

cases.covers: pure ASCII NUL-terminated string caches the whole first 32-byte read block verbatim (stringmanage.cc:69-72) with isTruncated=false; a repeat query performs zero further loader attempts on both managers

byte 0xAD matches no UTF-8 lead-byte prefix (stringmanage.cc:390-391 -> -1 -> checkCharacters -1); the map entry allocated BEFORE the read (stringmanage.cc:437) stays cached empty; the repeat query performs zero further attempts — the negative-cache occupancy proof and the hugehelp 0x7180/0x99a8/0xc1d8 rule

2050-char string with NUL at byte 2050: native StringManagerUnicode returns the empty negative buffer (search clamped at 2048 bytes, stringmanage.cc:452-457) while the declared GhidraStringManager/Java contract returns 2048 'A' + explicit NUL (2049 bytes) with isTruncated=1 (return truncation only) — both oracle behaviors locked on identical bytes

rule-side isString (ruleaction.cc:7375 shape) followed by print-side getStringData (printc.cc:1537 shape) on one Architecture-owned manager: the print query is served from the rule query's cache entry, attempts unchanged — the B4 shared-model proof
DataUnavailError (address outside every region) and the unbounded search reaching the image end without a terminator both leave the occupied empty entry cached; repeats perform zero further attempts
a real Datatype carrying the opaque_string flag (type.hh:176) takes the stringmanage.cc:441-442 early exit: empty entry cached with zero loader attempts

registerInternalStringData (stringmanage.cc:185-199): legal bytes return the non-zero CRC32^offset<<32 hash (init 0x7b7c66a9) and cache at the constant hash address; illegal 0xAD bytes return 0; hash value identical to Rust calc_internal_hash
runner executes each side twice and compares the complete ordered stdout byte-for-byte before the bilateral comparison

covered_projection.observation: per-query byteData length + hex head/tail + isTruncated + isString + cache-entry existence + per-offset loader attempt counts + final entry counts
covered_projection.comparison: both sides run twice for determinism, then complete stdout is compared byte-for-byte
